record.name: Rear-left drum static install and removal FSM contract
record.sourceLocator: Assembly FSM fileID 112903; Removal FSM fileID 105234

tolerance.notes: State graph is exact for the hashed YAML; runtime behavior is not claimed validated.

record.rawObservation: Assembly accepts tag PART and child drum brake(Clone), requires Trailarm_RL.Data.Installed=true and Trailarm_RL.Data.Bolted=true, then sets Drumbrake_RL.Data.Installed=true, activates GO 4017 and destroys the loose part. Removal requires TriggerWheelRL_New active and Drumbrake_RL.Data.Bolted=false, then clears Installed/Bolted, spawns drum brake prefab GUID 7ea6e4a1b669a4343807ab188c22efb5 at the trigger, reactivates the trigger and deactivates the installed owner.

normalizedValue.textValue: STATIC_PARTIAL: install and removal gates traced; runtime snap, blocked-case presentation and repetition pending

record.notes: TriggerWheelRL_New activity is an exact gate; interpreting it as wheel-absence state remains an inference until runtime observation. No donor FSM code is copied into runtime.

record.name: Rear-left drum serialized fastener stage contract
record.sourceLocator: BoltPM Screw FSM fileID 107744; installed drum BoltCheck FSM fileID 105233

tolerance.notes: Exact discrete threshold in the hashed YAML.

record.rawObservation: Stage is clamped to 0..8. TIGHTEN adds 1 to Stage and +1 to BoltCheck.Tightness; UNTIGHTEN subtracts 1 and -1. BoltCheck uses BoltedYES=8 and BoltedNO=0, writes Data.Bolted=true at Tightness>=8 and false at Tightness<=0, and disables/enables the drum interaction collider respectively. Screw has an unused/default local BoltSize value of 0.
record.notes: Eight is a discrete completion stage, not a torque or physical turn count. Screw.BoltSize=0 is not the tool-size contract; tool selection and scroll direction are recorded separately. Runtime evidence now verifies three complete forward/reverse progressions; physical torque and stripping/failure remain outside this donor contract.

record.name: Rear-left drum tool-selection and scroll-input contract
record.sourceLocator: BoltPM T 48747; PLAYER/Raycast Check FSM fileID 105041; PLAYER tool pickup FSM fileID 110228; spanner 14 child T 68967

tolerance.notes: Serialized FloatCompare tolerance for marker-scale versus ToolWrenchSize.

record.rawObservation: Check tool reads target Bolt x scale and compares it with global ToolWrenchSize. BoltPM x scale is 1.4; spanner 14 child mesh x scale is 1.4. Tool pickup writes the held spanner child x scale into ToolWrenchSize. Mouse ScrollWheel FloatCompare maps less-than-zero to UNTIGHTEN and greater-than-zero to TIGHTEN.
record.notes: This resolves the serialized tool/input mapping independently of Screw.BoltSize=0. Runtime evidence explicitly shows wrench 14 and three accepted complete forward/reverse progressions.

record.name: Runtime rear-left drum install and fastener repetitions

tolerance.notes: Sequential frame sample interval; exact input-event timestamps and internal stage values are not visible.

record.rawObservation: Rear-left trailing arm is installed and bolted during setup. HUD explicitly selects wrench 14 before the first drum trial. Three separate cycles each show loose drum placement, accepted wrench interaction through opposite forward/reverse phases, return to removable state and successful drum removal. Outcomes are visually identical; the rear-left wheel is absent throughout.
record.notes: Combined with the exact static 0..8 and scroll-direction contracts this closes P0-ASSEMBLY-FASTENER-SEMANTICS. Together with the separate wheel-blocked removal attestation and the static absence of an angular compare, it also supports the Covered mount rule.
